title: Studio host port request
description: The body of one host port operation call: the argument the operation takes and the envelope every operation carries. A host validates this shape before dispatching, so a malformed envelope is refused as invalid-request rather than partially honoured.

arguments.description: The operation argument. Absent for operations that take only the envelope.

requestContext.description: The request envelope. Actor identity and authorization evidence are attached by the trusted transport and never appear here: a Studio-supplied actor value is display context, never authentication.

expectedRevision.description: The revision the caller believes is current. Required by every operation the registry marks expectsRevision; a mismatch conflicts and the host returns the safe current revision.

idempotencyKey.description: Present when a mutation may be retried. A host that has already accepted this key for this operation returns the original outcome rather than applying the mutation twice.

locale.description: The locale for localized diagnostics. Absent means the session locale.

operationId.description: The capability identifier of the operation being invoked, closed by the operation registry.

protocolVersion.description: The negotiated wire version. A version the host does not support is refused as incompatible before any work.

requestId.description: Unique per call, used for correlation. It never identifies the actor.

resourceContextKey.description: The opaque, non-secret, non-bearer context key. The host resolves and verifies the canonical context from this key rather than trusting client-supplied scope values; a stale, altered or cross-session key is rejected without disclosing private resource existence.

sessionGeneration.description: The generation the session was opened at. A superseded generation is refused, because a permission or context change mints a new one.

traceContext.description: Trace correlation permitted by privacy policy. It carries no actor identity, credential or private resource value.
